name: Ox
sourceRole: The local first-printing supplies the rules. Publisher indexes corroborate identity.
errataEvidence: The Wizards 2021 v3.0 errata list no change to this profile.
sourceDistinctions: Page 207 directs the reader to use the Cow block for all cattle variants and apply the changes on p. 208. The base Charge adds damage without a saving throw.
Beast of Burden treats the Large ox as Huge solely for carrying capacity.
appearanceEvidence: Page 208 describes the ox as cattle kept chiefly for draft work. The draft-bovine silhouette is an editorial portrait choice.
habitatEvidence: The publisher’s legacy monster catalog lists Grassland. Farmland is editorial based on the draft work noted on p. 208.

name: Rothé
sourceRole: The local first-printing supplies the rules. Publisher indexes corroborate identity.
errataEvidence: The Wizards 2021 v3.0 errata list no change to this profile.
sourceDistinctions: Page 207 directs the reader to use the Cow block for all cattle variants and apply the changes on p. 208. The base Charge adds damage without a saving throw.
Ordinary Rothé gains 30-ft. Darkvision. The Medium size, 13 (2d8 + 4) HP, 60-ft. Darkvision, and innate dancing lights on the same page belong to Deep Rothé.
appearanceEvidence: Page 208 compares the ordinary Rothé to a musk ox. Fur and horn details describe the assigned portrait.
habitatEvidence: The publisher’s legacy monster catalog tags the ordinary Rothé as Grassland. The p. 208 Underdark entry refers to Deep Rothé.

sourceRole: The local first-printing supplies the rules. Publisher indexes corroborate identity.
errataEvidence: The Wizards 2021 v3.0 errata list no change to this profile.

appearanceEvidence: Page 208 specifies a misshapen orange and green bison. The exact shape and placement of colors are editorial choices in the assigned portrait.
habitatEvidence: Page 208 identifies the Lower Planes as its native habitat.

name: Swarm of Rot Grubs
sourceRole: The local first-printing supplies the rules. Publisher indexes corroborate identity.
errataEvidence: The Wizards 2021 v3.0 errata list no change to this profile.
sourceDistinctions: The swarm’s Bites infests on an attack hit without a separate save. The DC 10 DEX contact rule in the preceding prose is for one grub, which has no separate stat block.
The printed swarm only resists piercing and slashing, with no Stunned immunity line. Its Bites have no reduced damage at half HP.
appearanceEvidence: Page 208 specifies finger-sized maggots. Segmentation is an editorial depiction of the larvae.
habitatEvidence: Page 208 identifies corpses and decaying piles as infestation sites. The publisher’s legacy monster catalog also lists Swamp.
